description.en:
Returns the match clock, in whole seconds. It is the clock CMND_BTL_SET_MATCH_PHASE sets (the engine stores it in hundredths of a second and this function divides by 100).
The story scripts divide it by 60 to get the minute of a scripted goal, which they pass to CMND_BTL_SET_POINT_HISTORY together with the half.

Match time in seconds.
null if the match system is not ready.

examples.case: Timestamping a scripted goal (real usage, from btl0002.nut)
